spec_match.rationale: Checks the exact IDL: one-hop inheritance to ReadableStream.prototype, getStats as the subclass's own single method, base-class non-pollution, inherited getReader, and the illegal-constructor rule.

interactive.rationale: Two buttons walk the real prototype chain into a rendered chain + checks table and construct a real transport to inspect the container streams; results rendered from live objects.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises interface interrogation plus instance sources; both panels exist and do exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Absent-interface branch is explicit (and distinguishes no-WebTransport from WebTransport-without-subclass); the container-vs-chunk distinction prevents the classic wrong-level probe; chunk typing is honestly deferred to a manual conformance assertion.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5109912169480192 and the spec interface section.

conformance.rationale: New 9-assertion feature suite: existence, direct inheritance, own getStats, unpolluted base, inherited reader methods, illegal constructor, plain-stream negative, plus two honest manual assertions (live stats invariant, transferability); executes 1 pass / 6 fail / 2 blocked on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): both buttons driven at 1280×900 and 360×740, overflowX 0 on both, zero failed requests, screenshots read; the only console entries are the page's intentional logs and the browser's net-layer line for the deliberate dead-endpoint attempt. Partial: the interface-present path needs a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts shape consistency on supporting builds, container reality, and the explicit fallback; ready/closed claimed everywhere.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; chain pills and yes/no cells keep AA pairs on bg-paper/bg-stone; buttons set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned checks table with th scope, native buttons, one polite output per panel, chain rendered as a list.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; long member names wrap; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the shape checks on a Chrome 158+ build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the page can only show the honest absent branch. On a 158+ or WebTransportReceiveStream-flagged build, confirm all five shape checks go green and the conformance route reads 7 pass / 2 blocked (the two manual live-session assertions).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption/th scope in an overflow wrapper; wrap long tokens so narrow viewports do not overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shape-checks table uses caption + scope inside .table-wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere; chain items wrap as flex pills; measured 0px page overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per surface; meaningful announcements; no color-only signals.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each panel has a single aria-live output carrying the final verdict; pass/fail cells carry full text alongside color.

summary: Prototype-chain walk, five IDL shape checks, and a real container inspection on a connecting transport. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: honest absent branch, clean console/network apart from the intentional dead-endpoint net-layer line, 0px overflow both classes.
